lines: Clear water wells up through white stone. It tastes of nothing at all, which up here is a luxury.

sign: Under the Gilt House the gold runs like water. The Rift drinks it. So does the family.
heir: Leopold: Father says the Rift is family business. Everything is family business. Even you.
heir_intro: Leopold: I'm the third heir. I need a win. Any win.
heir_defeat: Leopold: Don't tell Father. Actually, do. He'll be pleased someone beat me.

lines: My family built every roof you admired on the way up. Gold on top, bones in the walls. Welcome home.
Aurek: Mended. Good. Come to the feast tonight. Sit next to me. Taste everything first.
Aurek: My children send their love. And a food taster's bill.

aurek_intro: My family built every roof you admired on the way up. Gold on top, bones in the walls. Welcome home.
aurek_defeat: Take the Rift. My children will take the house from me by dinner anyway. They learned from the best.
